How many more pages did Denise read than Daniel? Denise and Daniel are reading the same book. Yesterday, Denise read 10 pages. Yesterday, Daniel read 13 pages. Today, Denise read 5 more pages than Daniel read yesterday. Today, Daniel was not able to read any pages.
